notes: Negative vectors. Every case MUST fail with exactly expected_error; a decoder that accepts the frame, or fails with a different stable code, fails conformance. The decode validation order is part of the wire contract (protocol/wire/frame.go).

cases.name: empty_input
cases.description: Zero bytes cannot hold the magic.

cases.name: one_byte
cases.description: A single byte cannot hold the magic.

cases.name: truncated_header
cases.description: Valid magic but only 20 of 58 header bytes.

cases.name: unsupported_major_version
cases.description: Version 0x20 (v2.0): differing MAJOR nibble fails closed (ADR-007).

cases.name: bad_header_length
cases.description: header_length declares 57; protocol v1 headers are exactly 58 bytes.

cases.name: unknown_type_critical
cases.description: Unknown class 0x77 with the critical flag fails closed (TRS-PROTO-006).

cases.name: reserved_flag_critical
cases.description: Reserved flag bit set together with the critical flag.

cases.name: reserved_byte_critical
cases.description: Non-zero reserved byte together with the critical flag.

cases.name: payload_exceeds_class_bound
cases.description: HELLO declaring a 2000-byte payload; the class bound is QR_BOOTSTRAP_MAX_BYTES=1228. Checked before allocation (TRS-PROTO-007).

cases.name: payload_truncated
cases.description: Payload declares 24 bytes but only 20 are present.

cases.name: trailing_garbage
cases.description: One byte beyond the declared payload.
